title: Course Schedule
statement:
There are `numCourses` courses labeled 0..numCourses-1. `prerequisites[i] = [a, b]` means course a requires course b first. Return True if all courses can be finished, else False.

Example: numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1, 0]] -> True
hints: Model courses as a directed graph: edge b -> a means b before a. What's the forbidden structure?
It's cycle detection. A course schedule is feasible iff the graph is a DAG.
Use DFS with 3 colors (unvisited / in-stack / done), or Kahn's algorithm peeling zero-in-degree nodes.
complexity: Time O(V + E), space O(V + E) — DFS cycle detection.
